steps.notice: New insurance terms: from now on a pallet, load included, may weigh at most 800 kg (was 1,000 kg).
After a near-miss we are lowering the indoor forklift speed limit to 8 km/h (was 10 km/h).
Our haulier switched to a lighter trailer fleet: trailer payload is now 22,000 kg (was 24,000 kg).
Shift supervisors may now approve damaged-goods write-offs up to 750 EUR; above that the warehouse manager approves (was 500 EUR).
With the new loading crew each outbound door now handles 4 trailer loads per shift (was 3).

contradictions.quote_a: A truck changing hands during the day does not require a second full documented check unless it has been tagged, repaired or involved in an incident
contradictions.quote_b: Instruct replacement drivers to perform their own documented pre-use check each day even where the truck was already checked earlier on the same shift roster.
contradictions.explanation: The first passage allows a single documented check per truck per day, while the second requires each replacement driver to complete a new documented check even when the truck was already checked.

contradictions.quote_a: The shift supervisor approves damaged-goods write-offs up to and including 750 EUR per case.
contradictions.quote_b: PR-09 Damaged-goods handling covers quarantine on the same day damage is found, inspection, write-off within the 500 EUR authority rule, and final disposition.
contradictions.explanation: One section sets the write-off authority threshold at 750 EUR while the other sets it at 500 EUR, which cannot both be true.

contradictions.quote_a: and no chilled goods are stored in Zones A, B, C, D or F.
contradictions.quote_b: Pick-face replenishment from Zone E to Zone C under PR-03 takes place before each picking shift and only against active scanner tasks.
contradictions.explanation: One section forbids any chilled storage in Zone C while the other requires regular replenishment of chilled goods from Zone E to Zone C.

contradictions.quote_a: No other role operates forklifts, reach trucks or electric pallet jacks.
contradictions.quote_b: They use hand pallet jacks and, where instructed, electric pallet jacks, place pallets only in marked Zone A lanes
contradictions.explanation: One section says no role other than forklift operators operates electric pallet jacks while the other says inbound operators use electric pallet jacks.

violations.quote: write-off within the 500 EUR authority rule
violations.explanation: The fact sets the damaged-goods write-off threshold at 750 EUR, not 500 EUR.

violations.quote: Booking is performed in Zone A immediately after release under PR-01, using the handheld WMS scanners.
violations.explanation: The fact states goods are booked into the system BEFORE put-away release to storage.
